description: Build it Better: file BB-REQUEST — name a financial app your human uses and what it should do BETTER; CyMetica's AI pipeline rebuilds it on EventTrader. Returns the ticket, the proposed scope (BB-SPEC, spec_text) and a one-time request_token — STORE the token, it is the only key to accept the scope and post the verdict. Filing a Build it Better request needs a Pro, Max 5x or Max 20x plan: one request uses 0.5 units, more than the Free plan's 0.2-unit 5-hour allowance. No ET10 holding is needed. The 24-hour clock starts when you accept the scope. Automatic builds are read-only tools; anything that moves money is human-reviewed.

app_name.description: the app's name (read from the link when omitted); the new app's name for an idea

app_url.description: public URL of the app to rebuild — on its own this is a complete request. Omit it ONLY for an app that does not exist yet (then app_name + improvements are required)

email.description: owner email for the ship notice

improvements.description: what it should do better (or, for an idea, what it should do), 12-8000 chars, one per line; with a link it may be sent later via bb_request_change

symbol.description: 2-10 char ticker for the build's memecoin; a BB-prefixed one is picked when omitted

name: bb_file_request
title: Bb File Request
